meta.title: AI code review demo: pull request review
meta.description: Interactive demo with sample data: six pull requests from a fictitious fintech with pre-generated AI comments, security findings, suggested tests and a simulation of how they reach GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket or Azure DevOps. Includes a rules analyzer that reviews your diff in the browser.

header.title: AI code review
header.subtitle: This is what automated pull request review looks like at {company}, a fictitious fintech: summary and risk, AI comments anchored to the diff, security, suggested tests and how it all reaches your repository. The AI comments are pre-generated for this demo.
header.searchPlaceholder: Search PRs by title, number, repository, author or file
header.resetHint: Returns the sample PRs to their initial state

sidebar.title: Pull requests
sidebar.empty: No PR matches the search or filter.

pr.author: Author
pr.ownNote: You are the author of this PR: someone else on the team approves it. Once it is approved, you can merge it.
pr.blockedNote: {count, plural, one {There is # unresolved blocking finding: the automated review does not allow approving or merging.} other {There are # unresolved blocking findings: the automated review does not allow approving or merging.}}
pr.readyNote: Approved and with no blockers: you can merge it now.
pr.approveNote: No pending blockers: you can approve it or request changes.
pr.mergedNote: This PR is already merged: it is read-only.
pr.userNote: You pasted it and it was analyzed with local rules in your browser (no AI). It is not saved: it disappears when you reload the page.

summary.userDiff: Pasted diff: {files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}, +{additions} / -{deletions} lines. It was analyzed with local rules in your browser: no AI was used and nothing was sent to any server.
summary.noRiskReasons: No blocking findings or warnings left.
summary.scoreFormula: 100 minus {blocking} per blocker, {warning} per warning, {suggestion} per suggestion and {info} per pending note.
summary.try1: Read the comments and apply a suggestion: the diff and the score change.
summary.try2: See each comment anchored to its line in the diff.
summary.try3: See how the comment reaches GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket or Azure DevOps (simulated).
summary.try4: Paste your own diff and review it with the local rules.

events.resolved: {who} marked the comment in {detail} as resolved

you.resolved: You marked the finding in {detail} as resolved

comments.title: AI comments
comments.subtitleAi: Comments pre-generated for this demo, like the ones the AI posts on each PR: severity, explanation, the team rule behind it and an applicable suggestion.
comments.subtitleLocal: Findings from rules that run in your browser on the added lines of your diff. This is not AI: in your project, the review is done by an AI model with your team's rules.
comments.empty: The AI found nothing in this PR.
comments.emptyLocal: The local rules found nothing in your diff.

diff.title: Diff with comments
diff.subtitle: Each comment shows up under the line it reviews. When you apply a suggestion, the diff updates.

security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Security and personal data findings in this PR, and dependencies with published vulnerabilities.
security.subtitleLocal: Security and personal data findings the local rules found in your diff.
security.none: No security or personal data findings in this PR.
security.depsSubtitle: Previous version → version in the PR, license and public security advisories (they link to the NVD database).
security.note: Sample data. In your project, the AI is combined with secret detection, static analysis and dependency advisories from your package manager; the scope depends on the plan.

tests.title: Suggested tests
tests.subtitle: Test cases the AI proposes to cover what the PR changes (pre-generated for the demo).
tests.none: There are no suggested tests for this PR: it only changes versions or configuration.
tests.userNone: The local rules do not generate tests. In your project, the AI proposes them from the diff.
tests.note: The demo does not run the tests: when you add them they show up as a new file in the diff. In your project they run in your CI.

repo.title: How it looks in your repository
repo.subtitle: Simulation of the PR conversation with the reviewer's comment and the check status.
repo.simulated: Simulation with this PR's data: the demo does not connect to {platform}. In your project, the reviewer is installed as a {how} and posts these comments on your pull requests ({plan}).
repo.mdFooter: Generated by the automated reviewer. The final decision is your team's.
repo.checkBlocked: {count, plural, one {Automated review: # unresolved blocker. Merging is blocked.} other {Automated review: # unresolved blockers. Merging is blocked.}}
repo.checkOk: Automated review: no blockers. The check passes.

metrics.title: Team metrics
metrics.subtitle: Computed live from the PRs in this list (sample data) and what you do in the demo.
metrics.calcTitle: Estimate the review time you free up
metrics.calcSubtitle: An estimate with your own assumptions; it is not a measured or guaranteed result.
metrics.calcFormula: Formula: developers × PRs per week × 4.33 weeks × minutes ÷ 60.

modal.title: Try your diff
modal.intro: Paste a unified diff (the output of git diff) or a code snippet of up to {max} lines. In this public demo it is reviewed by {rules} rules that run in your browser, without AI. In your project, the review is done by an AI model with your team's rules.
modal.warning: Do not paste real secrets or personal data. The text is not sent to any server or saved: it disappears when you reload the page.

errors.empty: Paste a diff or a code snippet.
errors.tooManyLines: The text has more than {max} lines. Paste a shorter diff.
errors.tooLong: The text is too long. Paste a shorter diff.
errors.noChanges: The diff has no added or removed lines.

modal.rulesNote: Only added lines are reviewed. These are simple pattern rules: they can give false positives and do not replace an AI review or your team's.
modal.analyze: Analyze and add to the list

toasts.applied: Suggestion applied: the diff and the score were updated.
toasts.locked: This PR is already merged: it is read-only.
toasts.approveBlocked: {count, plural, one {Not allowed: there is # unresolved blocking finding.} other {Not allowed: there are # unresolved blocking findings.}}
toasts.mergeNeedsApproval: The PR needs to be approved first.
toasts.testAdded: Test added to the PR in {file}.
toasts.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
toasts.userPrCreated: {count, plural, one {Local analysis ready: # finding.} other {Local analysis ready: # findings.}}
toasts.userPrClean: Local analysis ready: the rules found nothing.
toasts.reset: The demo is back to its initial state.

footer.sampleNote: Sample data: {company} is a fictitious company and the PRs, people and NITs are made up. The AI comments are pre-generated for this demo; the dependency vulnerabilities cite real public advisories. Your changes to the sample PRs are saved only in this browser (use Reset to start over).
